name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy (Simic cEDH)
notes:
DeckCheck scan of https://deckcheck.co/app/decklist/JN_b2ZV6IQ9l (creator rickell123456), CRISPI 9.25, Bracket 5. Numbers copied from the CRISPI panel, not inferred. Commander taken from DeckCheck's own Bracket 5 meta (#2). The corpus's first Simic deck and its third cEDH reference point.

CONSISTENCY 9 - "a dense suite of 11 targeted creature and artifact tutors, including Whir of Invention and Transmute Artifact, combines with high-impact card draw engines like Rhystic Study. The commander also functions as a repeatable pseudo-tutor from the command zone."

RESILIENCE 9 - "15 realizable combo permutations across several independent lines. Uncounterable threats like Hullbreaker Horror and utility channel lands provide robust answers through heavy disruption."

INTERACTION 10 - "31 interactive cards featuring 16 counterspells, 8 free protective spells, and flexible bounce removal."

SPEED 9 - band table maps Speed 9 to win turn 3. "Blazing combo speed, consistently achieving a win on turn 3. Turn 1 land plus Delighted Halfling or a positive mana rock; turn 2 land, cast Kinnan, tap the rock for doubled mana into a secondary rock or tutor; turn 3 Basalt Monolith, tap for four, untap for three." The steepest Speed reference in the corpus.
